PopupAnnouncement.name: RnG - Auto Master PT
PopupAnnouncement.en-US:
Dear valued customers,
We are pleased to announce the “Auto Master Preset” function in RnG Casino will be offered from {effectdate}.
As a Master, you are now allowed to set your Auto PositionTaking on your Agent/Member in RnG Casino product.
Thank you.
